text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
............
...I haven't run enough. I need more—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, insane!
This filter made you look crazy good!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
Everyone's been saying so~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I thought about going for a cool look, but...
yup, cute is just totally invincible~♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Cute is... invincible?
...What a strange notion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...That was what I overheard.
It is clearly different from what I strive for, but...
it has piqued my curiosity somewhat.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To think you came to me with such a serious face
just to ask about that... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
'Cute is invincible', is it?
Well... frankly speaking, I can somewhat understand the sentiment.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Is... that so?
On what grounds could it possibly be called the strongest...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It means that before an adorable creature,
one may feel that any amount of power is rendered completely meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, whether that—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Groove-san,
do you have a moment regarding the paperwork to submit to the Student Council?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, understood.
Dura, forgive me, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, please don't worry about it.
Thank you for sparing your time for me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Rendering any power meaningless... is it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly believe it would be of any use in races, but...
to dismiss it before learning would also be... hm.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheva-chii~♡
Listen, listen, I'm going to a dance party with some friends soon, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not going.
I'd rather—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~?! Then at least, at least,
accompany me for dance practice!
Please? ♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
G-Geez...
I guess I have no choice...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow. *Purr, purr, purr*...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
............
...Would videos be better than an encyclopedia?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the library, I found Duramente
staring intently at a "Cute Animals Encyclopedia" with a grave expression.
Curious, I called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —And that is the situation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We moved to another spot and I listened to her explanation. ...I see.
Now that she harbored a doubt, she seemed determined
to genuinely study the concept of "cuteness."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...What do you think?
What elements do you believe
are essential for 'cuteness'?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The way she danced seemed cute to me.
As did the cat's sweet purring voice...
and the fluffy appearances shown in the encyclopedia...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...What should I take as reference
to learn the cuteness that leads to invincibility?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After thinking about it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing about the cat's sweet voice brought that image to mind.
I didn't think that was the true definition of cute, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Like the cat that was acting affectionate at my feet earlier...
using a high-pitched voice...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Assuming she was trying to test it out,
I waited quietly, and then—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... how to produce it.
...Phew. It seems
there are other things I must learn first...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente maintained an entirely serious demeanor.
Once she started something, she had to see it through to the end...
That was what her eyes seemed to convey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After thinking—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cute things tend to have
cute gestures or movements... right?
When I gave my offhand thought—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Cheva-chiii~...
...Like, this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is this... an imitation of Vivlos?
The pose was certainly cute, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Delivered in her usual stern tone of voice, the sense of mismatch was inescapable,
so I asked if anything else came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The way animals... sleep was cute.
It may not strictly be a movement, but...
let me try it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente slowly lay down
and curled up into a ball right on the spot.
However, she immediately stood back up—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...
I feel like... this isn't it either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, she awkwardly averted her gaze.
...Her quest for 'cute is invincible'
still had a long way to go.
